data: What is the BLEU score of the brown line when the vocabulary size is 5000?

The brown line represents the 'Most frequent' selection strategy in the figure. To determine the BLEU score of this line at a vocabulary size of 5000, I need to locate the point where the brown line intersects with the x-axis value of 5000 on the horizontal axis. From the graph, it appears that the brown line reaches approximately 16 on the y-axis when the x-axis value is 5000. Therefore, the BLEU score of the brown line at a vocabulary size of 5000 is around 16.
